Done. Summary:

- `out/T3/solution.py`: reads the input safetensors, drops the 12 `h.<i>.attn.bias` buffers, casts the 48 named projection weights to bfloat16, keeps all other 100 tensors float32, runs 6 assertions (including the 4 required checks) before writing, then greedily bin-packs tensors into ≤64 MiB shards (oversize `wte.weight` alone) and writes `model.safetensors.index.json`.
- `out/T3/run.sh`: thin wrapper invoking the script.
- Ran it once — succeeded first try: 148 tensors across 4 shards (3 ≤64 MiB, one holding just `wte.weight` at ~154 MB), 48 bfloat16 / 100 float32.
- `out/T3/REPORT.md` written with the self-report.
